probe_finding: Definition (author's charts, data: PFF, eligibility 100+ snaps): y = pass rush wins + stops through 5 games, x = total defensive snaps; quadrants: top-right every-down producers ('EDGE 1' / 'IDL 1'), top-left 'GIVE HIM SNAPS' (producing on small volume), bottom-right 'LOOK ELSEWHERE' (big workload, no production), bottom-left 'A WASH'. Stamped instances: EDGE elite — Aidan Hutchinson (~60 wins+stops, ~325 snaps), Greg Rousseau, Will Anderson Jr.; iDL leaders — Alim McNeill, Jeffery Simmons, Zach Allen (DEN), Deone Walker, Byron Murphy II, Dexter Lawrence, Leonard Williams. Tonight's relevance: Zach Allen's leader-list position is the production basis under the SEA@DEN dossier's trench premise (P-SEA-DEN-013, trench pressure / turnover cascade), corroborated by C-299 (Allen +2.2 sacks over expected).
